title_en: In the Municipality of Paris, Super Apartment 2+1+2 Totally Invested for Sale !!
description_en: In the Municipality of Paris, Super Apartment 2+1+2, Totally Invested, for sale. The apartment has just been invested from scratch, including electrical, plumbing, modern furniture, inverter air conditioning, AC5 flooring, thermal windows, etc. The apartment is also a good investment opportunity as it can be rented for up to 1500 euros.
